content: स्मृतिः {%f.%} [स्मृ-क्तिन्] .²1 Remembrance; recollection, memory; अश्वत्थामा करधृतधनुः किं न यातः स्मृतिं ते <ls>Ve. 3. 21</ls>; संस्कारमात्रजन्यं ज्ञानं स्मृतिः <ls>T. S.</ls>; स्मृत्युपस्थितौ इमौ द्वौ श्लोकौ <ls>U. 6</ls>, <ls n="U.">4. 2</ls>. .²2 Thinking of, calling to mind. .²3 What was delivered by human authors, law, traditional law, the body of traditional or memorial law (civil or religious) (<ab>opp.</ab> श्रुति). .²4 A code of laws, law-book. .²5 A text of Smṛti, canon, rule of law; इति स्मृतेः. .²6 Desire, wish. .²7 Discrimination, discretion; स्मृतौ हतायां भृतमानदुर्दृशः <ls>Bhāg. 4. 3. 17</ls>. .²8 Understanding.
